jump_nonattack.action: The exact attached accepted native-RIGHT three-quarter bell/clock-helmet hero, body only in charcoal cloth shirt/trousers and original brown gloves/boots. This is ONE continuous nonattack jump-to-land action, six genuinely articulated poses, not6 different identities. Same rigid squat helmet volume, original crooked top knob, two contained amber eyes, same head/torso/limb anatomical scale and heavy hand-inked contours as the identity anchor. Preserve416-source-pixel standing-equivalent anatomical scale on512 cells: naturally tucked poses are shorter, NEVER zoom or independently fit them. Keep the torso/pelvis spatial reference consistent across the strip; actual world vertical translation comes from the game, do not draw a row of higher/lower world positions. Do not force a boot baseline for airborne poses. No armor/chest/shoulder plates, no sword/handle/shield/staff/rod, no ground/shadow/dust/FX. Future armor and sword are separate modules. Both near and far hands must be real connected wrist/thumb/fingers and arms; no detached gloves, painted socket dots or copied frozen hands. Near hand maintains a natural compact later one-hand grip, but author grip/axis is unknown until actual pixels exist. Body owner is only the accepted frame0; no old canonical/alternate art. Exact left-to-right progression: 0 EARLY RISE: legs push away and begin a genuine knee tuck, connected arms draw in, torso subtly extends; not standing Ready. 1 LATE RISE: both knees tuck more, boots and hips visibly articulate, near/far elbows and wrists naturally adjust. 2 APEX: compact readable floating suspension, knees tucked with distinct boot angles, rigid helmet settles without stretching. 3 DESCENT: legs reopen downward to prepare contact, ankles and shoulders brace, distinct from rise/apex; torso anatomical scale unchanged. 4 LANDING IMPACT: authentic knee/hip compression under weight, boots receive support and connected arms counterbalance; no impact effect and no whole-sprite rotation. 5 LANDING SETTLE: knees/torso reopen toward the actual accepted Ready anatomy, hands remain naturally connected; no exact paste of the idle. In game frames0..3 sample actual H/V, frames4..5 use the already existing .12s landing age. The standard10fps preview is only an author preview, not the gameplay clock.
